# MauQuota 2.0.0

MauQuota 2.0.0 replaces the bundled Codex App Server integration with a native Swift OAuth and direct HTTP implementation.

## Highlights

- Added ChatGPT browser sign-in using OAuth Authorization Code + PKCE with a loopback callback.
- Store this app's access token, refresh token, ID token and account ID independently in macOS Keychain.
- Fetch Codex usage directly from ChatGPT's `/backend-api/wham/usage` endpoint.
- Read reset-credit details and redeem a selected credit through the corresponding `/wham/rate-limit-reset-credits` endpoints.
- Refresh expiring tokens automatically and retry a request once after HTTP 401.
- Preserve reset idempotency keys, safe retry behavior and local reset history.
- Removed the bundled Codex App Server, its download and runtime discovery, and all App Server subprocess JSON-RPC code.
- Keep the existing native menu bar, dual-ring quota display, bilingual interface, refresh scheduling and reset-credit window.

## Memory and runtime improvements

- Use a dedicated ephemeral `URLSession` with response caching, cookies and URL credential storage disabled.
- Limit per-host HTTP connections and invalidate the session when the app terminates.
- Release the reset-credit window controller and its AppKit view hierarchy when the window closes.
- Use autorelease pools around background network operations to shorten the lifetime of temporary Foundation objects.

## Build and validation

- 34 unit tests passed.
- Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64) release builds passed.
- GitHub Actions produces separate DMG installers and a `SHA256SUMS` file.

## Compatibility and security notes

- Requires macOS 13 or later.
- The DMG is ad-hoc signed and is not notarized by Apple; Gatekeeper may show a first-launch warning.
- MauQuota uses ChatGPT web-backend endpoints under `/backend-api/wham/*`. These are not stable public APIs and may change without notice.
- The OAuth client configuration follows the currently used Codex CLI public client identifier and login flow. OpenAI may change authorization requirements or endpoint behavior at any time.
- MauQuota does not bypass account permissions or server-side usage limits.
- MauQuota does not read or modify `~/.codex/auth.json`. Existing users may need to sign in again after upgrading because v2.0.0 stores its own credentials in macOS Keychain.

## Upgrade from v1.9.0

Install the new DMG over the existing app, launch MauQuota, and complete ChatGPT sign-in if prompted. No Codex CLI, Node.js or separately installed runtime is required.
